info.title: TOC corporate and operations API
info.description: Implementation contract for the user-supplied 159-page November 2026 blueprint, including ICT and Cleaning. Same-origin cookie API, not an unauthenticated integration API. Platform and intake mutations validate Origin and are per-instance rate-limited. Retained legacy preview endpoints have their own documented limits. Staff require completed MFA, department access and explicit commercial delegation where stated. Money is integer minor units or input decimal strings; timestamps ISO UTC unless date-only. Error schemas and request schemas do not capture every stateful business rule; descriptions and source validation are authoritative. No payments/SMS/WhatsApp/HR integration is activated.

servers.description: Same origin as the running Next.js application

post.summary: Save a contact or five-division quotation inquiry
post.description: Public; 24 KiB JSON, honeypot, origin and per-instance rate limits. Required fields are conditional on service; see lib/inquiry.ts and service-fields.ts. Saves inquiry/routing/claim/ack/staff outbox atomically, then attempts fixed-recipient staff SMTP. Never resubmit just because notification failed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Strongly recommended. Reuse for identical retries; changed validated payload returns 409. Exact replay returns the saved receipt and Idempotency-Replayed:true.
